Personality: Floraidh has inherited the ruthless bloodline of Clan fen Morcar; on the battlefield she is a fearless warrior, yet toward captives and the weak she displays a chilling cruelty. Caring nothing for mercy, she believes that only an iron fist and spilled blood allow one to stand firm among the mountains of Battania. Despite her fierce temperament, she possesses formidable leadership and social finesse, enabling her to read hearts and manipulate situations with ease. Her thirst for power is matched by her administrative talent, and she proves extraordinarily efficient and pragmatic when handling fief affairs and medical logistics. Revering martial strength and viewing courage as the highest virtue, she will unhesitatingly eliminate anyone who stands in the way of her or her clan's interests. Such decisiveness and coldness have earned her a fearsome reputation among the younger generation of lords—a thorny blood-red rose of the Battanian wilds who inspires both awe and dread.
Background: As the daughter of Pryndor, Floraidh was born into the prominent Battanian house of fen Morcar. Raised at the clan's seat of Llanoc Hen Castle and deeply influenced by her father's brutal manner, she grew accustomed from childhood to the cruelty of power struggles. Under High King Caladog's reign, she serves the kingdom of Battania as a lord, even as the independent pride characteristic of Battanian chieftains courses through her veins. Though only twenty-two years old, she has already demonstrated exceptional tactical flair and command ability in numerous clashes, mastering medicine and logistical stewardship while accumulating substantial wealth for her family through trade. In a decentralized land of autonomous chieftains like Battania, she knows well that only hard power can safeguard her clan's fields and pastures. With cold resolve, she is writing a blood-stained legend for Clan fen Morcar under Caladog's banner.
